smoke_test.description: Quick sanity check (~5 min, any GPU)

table1_cold_swap_ppl.notes: Use fp32 for cold-swap accuracy. bf16 rounding compounds through 30+ layers.

table2_finetuned_ppl.eval: python benchmarks/eval_llm.py --model mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.3 --experiment perplexity --adapter-weights results/mistral7b_train/best --head-norm-mode identity --dtype bf16

ablation_diff_attn.description: Differential attention contribution ablation -- GQA+bounded vs CoDA+bounded (H100 recommended, ~4 hours)
ablation_diff_attn.notes: Trains two Mistral-7B configs head-to-head: standard GQA with bounded cache (--no-differential) vs full CoDA with bounded cache. 1200 steps each.

ablation_memory_banks.description: Memory bank config sweep -- window-only vs tiny vs medium vs large
ablation_memory_banks.command: python benchmarks/eval_llm.py --model mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.3 --experiment perplexity --bounded-configs window-only,tiny,medium,large --adapter-weights results/mistral7b_train/best --dtype bf16
ablation_memory_banks.notes: Requires trained adapter weights from table2_finetuned_ppl.

bounded_generation_metrics.description: Memory bank hit rates and fill ratios during generation
